field.name: nextLabel
field.comment: The text of the link to the next page (empty: no link is displayed)

field.name: previousLabel
field.comment: The text of the link to the previous page (empty: no link is displayed)

field.name: parentLabel
field.comment: The text of the link to the parent page (empty: no link is displayed)

field.name: loopSequence
field.comment: true: the last page is followed by the first one, and the other way around; false: the links stop at the ends

field.name: orderBy
field.comment: display_asc: the pages follow the order of the sitemap; display_desc: the reverse order; chrono_asc: they follow the date, oldest first; chrono_desc: the date, most recent first
